text: Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 是面向 Web 版 DSH 的工作章程插件，在 Host 注册状态、草稿、转换、通知和角色配置工具，并向系统提示注入当前会话的章程摘要；Web 客户端提供侧栏入口、会话状态按钮和只读章程面板。它把重要工作的目标、授权、责任人、写入者、证据、结果审查与恢复状态保存在配对存储中，支持直接、Team 和分阶段安排，配置冻结的角色模型，并通过原生 Team 传递通知。适合需要为持续或多人协作任务记录决策与交接的 DSH 用户。使用多角色安排需要原生 Team 组件；不需要额外 API 密钥。

Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness adds charter tools and session context to DSH, plus a Web sidebar and read-only panel. It records goals, roles, evidence, review, and handoffs for direct or Team work, and can route notices through native Agent Team. Multi-role use requires that service.
想给重要的 DSH 工作记录目标、授权和验收条件
有没有办法把协作任务的负责人、写入者和证据整理在一起
让 DSH 团队成员之间的结果和审查交接有记录可查
我想为不同职责的子角色固定模型选择并保留配置来源
如何查看当前会话关联的工作章程和运行状态
需要一个侧栏入口浏览各个任务章程和状态
I need a clear record of goals, authority, ownership, and acceptance for consequential DSH work.
Help me track role assignments and evidence across a multi-agent task.
Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「章程状态与转换」：创建未激活草稿，并按角色和版本条件推进提议、批准、暂停或恢复状态。
Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「协作通知」：记录结果、审查或负责人处置，再把通知发送给原生 Team 成员并保存交接状态。
Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「角色配置」：为已批准的命名角色选择完整模型对象并冻结，Lead 可在原生 Team 中创建对应角色。
Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「会话章程界面」：Web 侧栏打开章程面板，会话按钮显示活动或暂停状态，面板从远端读取章程列表。
Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness 的多角色和通知能力依赖已加载的原生 Agent Team；默认 bundle 只挂载插件本身，因此单独使用时应采用直接安排。

work-charter-dsh README · Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

WCDP adapts the installed Codex Work Charter **0.9.1** to DeepSeek Harness. It records the outcome, authority, responsibilities, writer, evidence, acceptance and recovery of consequential work. Ordinary stable work needs no Charter ceremony.

work-charter-dsh README · Work Charter for DeepSeek Harness：The **0.2.0-alpha.1** release line uses contract **2** and logical storage schema **2**, targeting DSH **0.1.7-rc.2** at `477b4f420553e8a52c2fbccc464d7561b239c443`. Distribution is a [GitHub Pre-release](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.2.0-alpha.1); package metadata retains `private: true`, with no npm publication. Publication state and qualification limits live in [STATUS](docs/STATUS.md) and [VERIFICATION](docs/VERIFICATION.md); the normative scope is [SPEC](docs/SPEC.md#successor-design-work-charter-091-and-scdp-retirement).

work-charter-dsh README · Native Team and Charter policy：The successor removes the `session-coordinator-dsh` runtime dependency. Native DSH supplies Team membership, persistent teammates, mailbox delivery and restart. WCDP keeps only Charter-specific contract state, authority/evidence history, writer observations, result/review/disposition semantics, frozen role models and uncertain-handoff stopping.

work-charter-dsh README · Native Team and Charter policy：| Arrangement | Responsibilities | Native scope |
|---|---|---|
| Direct | primary, applicable independent R | primary Session; optional R in its native Team |
| Team | P, E, applicable independent R | P is Lead; flat teammates |
| Phased | O, P, E, applicable independent R | O is Lead; P owns E/R work and acceptance |

work-charter-dsh README · Native Team and Charter policy：Continuity (current-task/durable) is independent of arrangement. Contract approval is independent of active/paused/closed run state. R supplies technical review; primary/P/O owns outcome acceptance. Existing unrelated root Sessions, cross-Team work and multiple worktrees are outside this candidate's scope.

work-charter-dsh README · Native Team and Charter policy：The Host validates WCDP operations; the Client is read-only. WCDP does not lock files, grant permission, attest human approval, or enforce every DSH tool. Native delivery is not model inspection or semantic acceptance.

work-charter-dsh README · Composition and use：Use a **fresh isolated profile and paired storage** with the exact DSH packages above, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, Cordis `4.0.4` and shared UI React `18.3.1`. The default bundle patch mounts only WCDP on the base Host services (Agent, Session, tools, skills, system prompt and storage domain). No SCDP is mounted.

work-charter-dsh README · Composition and use：For multiple responsibilities the profile additionally supplies `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process` with provider name `spawn`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`, all pinned to the same DSH version. The optional native Team tool package may be added by the profile owner; WCDP role provisioning and notice tools call public Team services directly. Do not change an installed profile without installation authority.

work-charter-dsh README · Composition and use：Start from the Work Charter Skill and `work_charter_status`; the [packaged Skill](assets/work-charter-dsh.md) documents all five model tools and contract-2 JSON examples. New roles select complete model objects using 0.9.1 source precedence and freeze them before first dispatch. Supported selected parameters are `reasoning_effort` and `max_output_tokens`; unavailable models or unsupported parameters stop rather than silently changing the request. Existing Lead settings remain host-owned.

work-charter-dsh README · Composition and use：Keep Session logs and Charter storage together. A WCDP-marked native child stops if its paired Charter record is missing. Unknown sends remain durable stops; reconciliation records exact external native-log evidence and does not resend. Preserve old profiles and data: schema 1 is rejected, not automatically migrated.

work-charter-dsh README · Install into a new profile：Use an existing official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` installation and pnpm `11.7.0`. Download the versioned tarball and its SHA-256 sidecar from the Release page, verify the checksum, and choose an unused profile name:

```powershell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz
dsh --version
dsh --profile wcdp-new --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile wcdp-new add .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz --ignore-scripts

work-charter-dsh README · Install into a new profile：This installs the WCDP bundle over base/Web for Direct work; it does not enable native Team automatically. For Team/Phased, supply the native Team composition described above. Do not reuse a legacy WCDP/SCDP store. Repository archival of SCDP does not migrate an existing Charter or replace its old data.

work-charter-dsh README · Development and evidence：After an authorized dependency installation:

```text
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint

work-charter-dsh README · Development and evidence：Build emits Node ESM Host, generated read-only Remote, and the DSH lazy-CJS browser factory. Runtime qualification uses keyless deterministic adapters and fresh task-local stores; it does not establish natural-language quality or efficacy. Release qualification additionally installs into a fresh dependency graph, runs the native Host and jsdom Client checks there, and installs the bundle with the official DSH CLI into a fresh Web profile. Host health and authenticated HTTP startup pass. Actual browser UI remains unverified because the available browser tool blocked localhost navigation; jsdom and HTTP checks do not replace it.

work-charter-dsh README · Development and evidence：The previously published [v0.1.0-alpha.1 release](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.1), its DSH/SCDP graph and evidence remain historical, runnable subjects. Their results do not qualify this successor. Legacy audit/source/runtime scripts remain for that historical baseline and are not current package commands.

work-charter-dsh README · 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Work Charter：[English](README.md)

WCDP 把已安装的 Codex Work Charter **0.9.1** 适配到 DSH，记录关键工作的目标、授权、责任、写入者、证据、验收和恢复位置。普通稳定工作无需额外 Charter 仪式。

text:
work-charter-dsh README · SCDP 退役后的分工：候选版移除了 `session-coordinator-dsh` 运行依赖。DSH 原生 Team 负责成员、持久子角色、消息投递和重启；WCDP 只保留 Charter 专属的合同/授权/证据状态、写入观察、Result Notice、独立审查与验收、角色模型冻结和未知投递停步。

| 安排 | 责任 | 原生范围 |
|---|---|---|
| Direct | primary 和适用的独立 R | primary Session；需要 R 时使用同一原生 Team |
| Team | P/E 和适用的独立 R | P 是 Lead，其他为平级 teammate |
| Phased | O/P/E 和适用的独立 R | O 是 Lead；P 管理 E/R 工作及验收 |

连续性（current-task/durable）与安排分开；合同批准与 active/paused/closed 运行状态分开。R 提供技术审查，primary/P/O 负责接受结果。已有独立根 Session 的合并、跨 Team、多工作树协调不在此版范围内。
work-charter-dsh README · SCDP 退役后的分工：Host 校验 WCDP 自身操作，Client 只读。WCDP 不锁文件、不授予权限、不证明人工批准，也不强制约束所有 DSH 工具。原生投递成功不等于模型已阅读或结果已验收。

work-charter-dsh README · 运行与开发：使用全新的隔离 profile 和成对的 Session 日志/Charter store；保持精确 DSH 版本、Cordis `4.0.4` 和 React `18.3.1` 的单一身份。默认 bundle patch 只挂载 WCDP，Direct 可不加载 Team。

多角色 profile 还需同版本 `dsh-subagent`、`dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process`（provider 为 `spawn`）和 `dsh-experimental-agent-team`。WCDP 通过公开 Team 服务创建已批准角色和投递通知；原生 Team 工具是 profile 的可选能力。不要未经安装授权修改现有 profile。

work-charter-dsh README · 运行与开发：从 `work_charter_status` 和 [打包 Skill](assets/work-charter-dsh.md) 开始；其中提供五个工具的 JSON 合同。新角色按 0.9.1 的优先级选取完整模型对象，在首次调用前冻结；当前适配支持 `reasoning_effort` 和 `max_output_tokens`，不能支持的参数明确报错，不静默丢弃。现有 Lead 模型由 Host 保持。

缺失配套 Charter 数据时，带 WCDP 标记的子角色停止调用。未知投递禁止盲目重发；只有责任人核对原生日志后才能记录恢复证据，并显式恢复运行。旧 schema 不自动迁移，旧 profile/store 和发布证据保留。

work-charter-dsh README · 安装到新 profile：使用已有的官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` 与 pnpm `11.7.0`。从 Release 页面下载版本 tarball 和 SHA-256 校验文件，核对校验值后选择未使用过的 profile 名称：

```powershell
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz
dsh --version
dsh --profile wcdp-new --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile wcdp-new add .\work-charter-dsh-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz --ignore-scripts

work-charter-dsh README · 安装到新 profile：这条路径在 base/Web 上安装 WCDP bundle，供 Direct 使用，不自动启用 Team。Team/Phased 还需要上文所述原生 Team composition。不要复用旧 WCDP/SCDP store；SCDP 仓库归档也不等于迁移已有 Charter 或替换其数据。

开发验证顺序为 `pnpm build`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm lint`、`pnpm exec vitest run`、`pnpm verify:runtime`、`pnpm verify:client`、`pnpm release:audit`、`pnpm pack:check`。发布验证另建干净依赖图，在其中运行原生 Host 和 jsdom Client 检查，并通过官方 DSH CLI 把 bundle 安装进新 Web profile；Host health 和认证 HTTP 启动检查通过。浏览器工具阻止了 localhost 导航，实际浏览器 UI 仍未验证，jsdom 和 HTTP 不能替代它。无密钥确定性探针也不代表自然语言效果已验证。

work-charter-dsh README · 安装到新 profile：旧 [v0.1.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/junwei529/work-charter-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.1) 及其 DSH/SCDP 图是独立的历史发布对象，原有 PASS 不转移到候选版。旧 audit/source/runtime 脚本只服务其历史基线，不再作为当前 package 命令。
